data.narrative:
True Anomaly, a Defense & Security frontier-tech company at SPAC stage with $1B+ raised, is evaluated against a comp universe of 14 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier peers spanning 2 public companies and 8 private entities. Key private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems, with a valuation range extending from $1.0B to $9.2B across the peer set.

The peer-median approach is the applicable triangulation method here. The 14-company median valuation stands at $1.8B, establishing a direct benchmark against True Anomaly's current $2.2B valuation. The peer distribution—with a floor of $1.0B (early-stage entrants) and ceiling of $9.2B (Saronic at Series D)—reflects material heterogeneity in stage maturity and technology specificity within the Defense & Security sector. True Anomaly's position above the peer median suggests premium pricing relative to the cohort center.

The triangulated analysis supports a $1.5B to $2.0B range around the $1.8B median. True Anomaly's current $2.2B valuation sits above this band, implying either additional value not captured in peer comparables or elevated pricing relative to observable peers at similar developmental stages. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to peers, and product differentiation within an increasingly crowded frontier-defense market. Peer stage distribution and valuation dispersion ($1.0B–$9.2B) underscore material risk in any point estimate.
